technicalBaseline.postGateDelta: evidence/review/receipt files only; no runtime or schema delta

reason: The N8.1 acceptance condition explicitly requires real users to validate complete business processes. An automation can verify code, CI and evidence, but cannot truthfully impersonate a real business user or attest human acceptance.

requiredHumanUat.minimum: representative user executes product/variant and stock movement flow and verifies resulting stock/audit evidence
representative purchasing user executes purchase/receipt flow and verifies inventario and payable effects where applicable
representative sales user executes customer-sale-invoice flow and verifies totals, stock and document result
representative finance user executes payment/receivable/payable/accounting flow applicable to the tenant and verifies traceability
representative user validates at least one operational report/dashboard against source transactions
authorized users validate the same critical flow under separate tenant/company context and verify isolation plus permission denial for an unauthorized role
representative user validates one configured integration path and its safe failure/disabled behavior without exposing secrets

constraints: any FAIL becomes causal defect and must be fixed/retested before LISTO_REAL
nextSafeAction: A real authorized business user performs the listed UAT scenarios in the development environment and records evidence; VAEP then resumes N8.1.G, classifies/fixes any failures, verifies causal gates and only then may issue LISTO_REAL.
